A '''missile launcher''' turret model was used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The turrets fired [[seeker missile]]s from their dual barrels.<ref name="BFN" />In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Battle for Naboo'' itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> several [[Missile launcher/Legends|launchers]] were attached to the communications relay [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] [[Comm 4]] for defense. They were also part of the defenses at a [[Trade Federation base]]. Another launcher was found near [[Borvo]]'s base at [[Porso Hill]]. The Trade Federation [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Camp Four/Legends|Camp Four]] also had a turret placed in a valley.<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The missile launchers appear in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
